# Team-space settings: space approval rules, space vault, no personal keys or credits

## What to build

Make a team space act as itself rather than as whoever is asking. In a `kind: "team"` space: approval rules and auto-review always resolve from the space (shared by all members, never from a member's account defaults); the vault always resolves from the space (shared, any member can add and use, values never shown); a run never uses a member's personal model or voice credentials, only the deployment's providers, metered against the team space's organization credits when hosted billing is on. Private spaces keep today's "account defaults unless the space customizes" behavior unchanged. The space settings UI (web and mobile) hides the **Customize / Use defaults** switch for Approvals and Vault in team spaces, because they are always the space's.

## Decisions baked in

- Helper `isTeamSpace(prisma, spaceId)` (reads `Space.kind`), exported from `@rakazo/db`; cache nothing across requests.
- `settingsTarget(prisma, scope, setting, requested?)`: for `setting` `"confirmations"` or `"credentials"` in a team space, return `"space"` always (ignore `requested === "account"` by returning `"space"` and never reading account rows). `spaceSettings.setOverride` for those two settings in a team space → `BAD_REQUEST`. `spaceSettings.overrides` reports them enabled. `"models"` and `"voice"` keep per-member behavior (preferences only).
- Approval rules in a team space: list `actionApprovalRule` by `spaceId` only (dedupe by `effect, matchKind, matchValue`); save with `createdByUserId = actor` but skip insert if a rule with the same `(spaceId, effect, matchKind, matchValue)` exists; remove deletes all rows with that match in the space. Auto-review in a team space: read the most recently updated `actionAutoReviewPreference` row of the space; save updates all rows of the space and upserts the caller's.
- Vault in a team space: `vaultFields` returns `{ spaceId }` (no `userId`) for reads/updates/deletes; creates still write `userId` (creator); creating a name that already exists in the space → the existing duplicate-name error.
- Personal credentials in a team space: `resolveModelKey` / model selection must not use `UserModelCredential` rows of `run.userId` (treat `credential` as `null` and skip user credential lookups in `packages/adapters/src/model-selection.ts` 147 and 502); voice runs must not use `UserVoiceCredential`; `apps/api/src/team-chat-judge.ts` 267 and `apps/api/src/thread-image-admission.ts` 87-114 must not use personal keys in team spaces. With no deployment model configured, the run fails with the existing `UnavailableModelForAuthError(MISSING_MODEL_RUN_ERROR)`.
- Credits: already charged to the space's organization (`organizationForMember` / `hostedModelCreditObserver` / `spaceHasModelAccess` read `space.organization`); add a test proving a team-space run reserves credits on the team org and never on the member's personal org.

Already in the codebase: `Space.kind` (`"private" | "team"`), shared-space RLS (space vault rows readable by every member of the space), and `seedSharedSpaceFixture(prisma, { kind: "team" })` from `@rakazo/db` returning `{ organizationId, spaceId, owner, member, outsider, cleanup }`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/contracts/src/settings-scope.ts` 3-15 — `SpaceSettingSchema = ["models", "voice", "confirmations", "credentials"]`, `SettingsScopeSchema = ["account", "space"]`.
- `packages/db/src/space-settings.ts` — `settingsTarget` 37-51 (quoted below), `setSpaceSettingOverride` 75-105 (`lockSpaceSettings` 58-66), `copyAccountIntoSpace` 127-178, `clearSpaceCopy` 107-125, `spaceSettingOverrides`.
  ```ts
  export async function settingsTarget(prisma, scope, setting, requested?) {
    if (requested) return requested;
    const row = await prisma.spaceSettingOverride.findUnique({ where: { spaceId_userId_setting: { spaceId: scope.spaceId, userId: scope.userId, setting } }, select: { setting: true } });
    return row ? "space" : "account";
  }
  ```
- `packages/db/src/approval-settings.ts` 37-50 (`listApprovalRules`), 57-104 (`saveApprovalRule`), 106-120 (`removeApprovalRule`), 122-137 (`findAutoReviewPreference`), 140-167 (`saveAutoReviewPreference`).
- `packages/adapters/src/run-trust.ts` 75-95 — per-run resolution keyed on `{ userId: run.userId, spaceId: run.spaceId }` (works once the helpers above branch on team spaces).
- `packages/db/src/events.ts` ~975-985 — "always allow" saves via `saveApprovalRule(tx, { userId: approvalUserId, spaceId }, ...)`.
- `packages/adapters/src/bot-secrets.ts` 42-71 (`BotSecretScope`, `vaultFields`, `assertVaultInUse`), ~952 (run lookup), `packages/adapters/src/run-secret.ts` 167.
- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` 308-337 (`ActionApprovalRule`, `ActionAutoReviewPreference`), 1786-1802 (`VaultCredential`, unique `(userId, spaceId, name)` NULLS NOT DISTINCT in SQL), 2055-2065 (`SpaceSettingOverride`).
- `packages/adapters/src/run-model.ts` 142-185 (`modelCreditBillingEnabled`, `resolveModelKey`: uses `hasHostedModelCredits`, then `resolveModelKeyMaterial(deps, userId, spaceId, credential, ...)`, `hostedModelCreditObserver` when `!credential && billingEnabled`), `packages/adapters/src/model-selection.ts` 147, 502, 863-875, `packages/adapters/src/model-credit-observer.ts` 14-41, `packages/db/src/billing.ts` 17-52, 201-218, `packages/db/src/model-credits.ts` 97-155.
- Voice: `apps/api/src/voice.ts` (135, 229, 312, 411, 448), `packages/db/src/voice-credentials.ts` 180.
- Web UI: `apps/web/src/pages/SpaceSettingOverrides.tsx` (Customize switches; mutations at 41-43, 95, 103) and its test; `apps/web/src/pages/SpaceSettingsPanel.tsx` (receives `space` with `kind`). Mobile: `apps/mobile/app/(settings)/space.tsx` (Customize group with Models, Voice, Approvals, Vault switches).
- Existing tests: `packages/db/src/approval-settings.test.ts`, `packages/testkit/src/bot-secrets.test.ts`, `packages/db/src/model-credits.postgres.test.ts`, `apps/api/src/model-credits.postgres.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/pages/SpaceSettingsPanel.test.tsx`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/space-settings.ts`, `packages/db/src/approval-settings.ts`, `packages/db/src/index.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** the rules above; add `isTeamSpace`.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/db check`

### UPDATE `packages/adapters/src/bot-secrets.ts` (vault) and the model/voice credential paths listed above
- **IMPLEMENT** team-space branches.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/adapters check && pnpm --filter @rakazo/api check`

### UPDATE web `SpaceSettingOverrides.tsx` and mobile `(settings)/space.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: when `space.kind === "team"`, do not render the Customize switch rows for Approvals and Vault (render their settings as the space's directly, same as an enabled override). No new copy. Mobile: no new strings; if a string is unavoidable add it to all 7 locales in `apps/mobile/lib/locales/*.ts` (gate: `apps/mobile/lib/i18n.test.ts`).

### CREATE `apps/api/src/team-space-settings.postgres.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** with `seedSharedSpaceFixture(prisma, { kind: "team" })`: owner has an account approval rule "always allow tool X" and member has none → in the team space `listApprovalRules({ userId: member, spaceId })` returns the space rules only (not owner's account rule); owner saves a space rule → member sees it; `setOverride` confirmations off → `BAD_REQUEST`; owner adds a space vault credential → a vault lookup for a run by member finds it; owner's account vault credential is not found; member has a personal `UserModelCredential` → `resolveModelKey` for a team-space run ignores it (with billing on and team org credits funded, `reserveModelCredits` is called with the team org id; the member's personal org balance is unchanged). Private-space regression: account defaults still apply when the space is not customized.
- Add unit tests for `SpaceSettingOverrides` hiding the two switches when `kind === "team"`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] In team spaces approval rules, auto-review and vault are always the space's and shared by all members.
- [ ] Team-space runs never use personal model or voice keys and never charge a member's personal credits.
- [ ] Private spaces behave exactly as before.
- [ ] UI hides Customize for Approvals and Vault in team spaces.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm exec vitest run packages/db/src packages/adapters/src apps/web/src/pages
pnpm --filter @rakazo/mobile test
pnpm test:integration -- --spec=team-space-settings
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
